name: swiss-barber
description: Swiss Barber - one backend, one database (swiss), website + admin & customer panels

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix panels/admin install && npm --prefix panels/customer install && npm --prefix website install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB,WEBJS,ADMIN,CUSTOMER -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:website" "npm run dev:website-assets" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:customer"
scripts.build: npm --prefix website run build && npm --prefix panels/admin run build && npm --prefix panels/customer run build
